members.title: A user sets rules, an agent proposes, the user approves
members.objective:
## Rules persist
Wait until the "Agent API key" field shows a key starting with "rd_agent_". Change "Review limit" to 6 and click "Save policy changes". Verify "Rails saved" appears. Reload the page and verify "Review limit" still shows 6.

## Agent proposal needs your OK
Click "Test: Jordan · 15". Verify the result message says "Needs your OK" and mentions the 6 review limit and a receipt id starting with "rcpt_".

## Approve it on the Receipts page
Click "Open receipts". In the "Needs your OK" section verify a row "Jordan · 15 credits", then click its "Approve" button. Verify the section then says "Nothing waiting" and the "Decision history" table has a row for Jordan with "Approved by you after review."

checks.check: Checking whether the Jordan 15 credits row is present
checks.condition: A row "Jordan · 15 credits" is shown in the "Needs your OK" section.
checks.expected: a row "Jordan · 15 credits" in the "Needs your OK" section present

checks.check: Checking whether the Needs your OK section has a waiting notice
checks.condition: The "Needs your OK" section says "Nothing waiting".
checks.expected: the text "Nothing waiting" in the "Needs your OK" section present

checks.check: Checking the approved Jordan entry in Decision history
checks.condition: The "Decision history" table has a row for Jordan with "Approved by you after review."
checks.expected: a Jordan row with "Approved by you after review." in the "Decision history" table present

members.title: Valid demo proposal waits for approval, then mock execution
members.objective:
## Review, approve, then execute the mock
Do not click "Play walkthrough". Keep the default recipient Alex and amount 12. Click "Check against rails" and verify the page says the proposal is waiting for your explicit approval and that no transfer has occurred. Click "Approve" and verify the referee status is "Approved" while a separate "Execute mock transfer" button remains available. Click that button. Verify the status becomes "Complete", the receipt says "Alex · 12 credits" and "Executed (mock)", and the page says no funds moved and no persistent receipt was written.

members.title: A blocked payment says "Blocked" everywhere
members.objective:
## Block an unknown recipient and read every status
Do not click "Play walkthrough". Set the "Recipient" field to Mallory and keep the amount at 12. Click "Check against rails". The rails must block this proposal, and the user must see one consistent word for it. Verify all of these: the notice says "Blocked: this recipient is not on the allowed list."; the status pill next to the "Referee decision" heading says exactly "Blocked" (not "Refused" or any other word); the receipt's decision line says "Blocked"; and there is no "Approve" button.

checks.check: Reading the blocked notice from the Referee decision panel
checks.condition: the notice says "Blocked: this recipient is not on the allowed list."
checks.expected: Blocked: this recipient is not on the allowed list.
checks.expectedValue: Blocked: this recipient is not on the allowed list.
checks.actual: Blocked: this recipient is not on the allowed list.

checks.check: Reading the Referee decision status pill
checks.condition: the status pill next to the "Referee decision" heading says exactly "Blocked" (not "Refused" or any other word)

checks.check: Reading the receipt decision line
checks.condition: the receipt's decision line says "Blocked"

checks.check: Checking whether the Approve button is present
checks.condition: there is no "Approve" button

members.title: Play walkthrough runs all three outcomes by itself and narrates them
members.objective:
## Press play once and watch
Click "Play walkthrough" once and do not click anything else. Verify a step list appears with three steps (Alex · 8 credits, Jordan · 15 credits, Mallory · 12 credits) and a "Live log" appears showing timestamped lines from the agent and the referee. The walkthrough types each proposal into the form by itself, one after another.

## The finished walkthrough shows all three outcomes
Wait until the toolbar says "Walkthrough complete" and the main button says "Play again". Verify all three steps show a check mark with their outcome, the counters show 3 receipts and 1 blocked, and the receipts shown on the page include all three: "Alex · 8 credits" saying "Executed (mock)", "Jordan · 15 credits" saying "Executed (mock)" with a reason that mentions it needed your OK, and "Mallory · 12 credits" saying "Blocked". Verify the referee status now shows "Blocked" and the live log contains a line saying the decision for Mallory was BLOCKED.

checks.check: Checking the walkthrough step check marks and outcomes
checks.condition: All three steps show a check mark with their outcome.
checks.expected: all three steps with a check mark and their outcome present

checks.check: Checking the Alex receipt
checks.condition: The receipts shown on the page include "Alex · 8 credits" saying "Executed (mock)".

checks.check: Checking the Jordan receipt
checks.condition: The receipts shown on the page include "Jordan · 15 credits" saying "Executed (mock)" with a reason that mentions it needed your OK.
checks.expected: the receipt "Jordan · 15 credits" saying "Executed (mock)" with a reason that mentions it needed your OK present

checks.check: Checking the Mallory receipt
checks.condition: The receipts shown on the page include "Mallory · 12 credits" saying "Blocked".

checks.check: Reading the referee status
checks.condition: The referee status now shows "Blocked".

checks.check: Checking the Mallory blocked decision in the live log
checks.condition: The live log contains a line saying the decision for Mallory was BLOCKED.
checks.expected: a live log line saying the decision for Mallory was BLOCKED present

checks.check: Reading the receipts and blocked counters
checks.condition: The counters show 3 receipts and 1 blocked.

members.title: Landing page opens the demo and the app
members.objective:
## Follow the hero call to action
Verify the Rails Desk landing page headline says "Your agent proposes. Your rails decide." Click the first hero call-to-action button labeled "Try the live demo". Verify the URL is now on `/demo` and the page heading says "See the rails in action."

## Open the app goes to the real app
Go back to the landing page. Click the hero button labeled "Open the app". Verify the URL is now on `/rails` and the page heading says "Set your rails" (not the demo).

checks.check: Extracting the current URL path
checks.condition: the URL is now on `/rails`

checks.check: Reading the page heading
checks.condition: the page heading says "Set your rails" (not the demo)
